title: Server: ready-up protocol before game starts
description: Add a ready-up phase between joining and game start. New room state: Waiting (players joining) → Ready (all seats filled and all players confirmed ready) → InProgress (first action applied). New WebSocket messages: ClientReady (player signals ready), ServerReadyState (broadcast current ready status of all seats). Game does not start until all seated players send ClientReady. Player can un-ready by sending ClientReady again (toggle). If a player disconnects during ready phase, their ready status clears. Timeout: optional auto-start N seconds after all seats filled (configurable per room, default: no auto-start).
close_reason: RoomPhase (Waiting/AllReady/InProgress), ready_players HashSet, Ready client message, handle_ready with broadcast ready_state. Disconnect clears ready. Backward compatible.
